When snapshots are omitted, the change in `abstract.py` replaces `n.snapshots` with `pd.Index(list(n.snapshots), tupleize_cols=False, name="snapshot")`, unconditionally flattening a MultiIndex into tuple labels. Thus, for a multi-period network with `optimization.model_snapshot_index="multiindex"`, it forces the snapshots passed to optimisation into a fixed flat representation rather than preserving the accepted MultiIndex form.
